messages:
incident-bot: PAGE FIRED: Detector 'inference-gateway-usw2-5xx-rate' exceeded threshold (5m avg 7.8% > 4%). Pager: P1. Escalation policy: inference-oncall -> sara. Links: https://pd.redwood.example/alerts/ABC123, dashboard https://dash.redwood.example/r/inference-gw
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert: Inference Gateway 5xx spike (P1) — Assigned to sara for ack. Incident created: INC-2026-142. Contact: @sara
sara: acked. I'm on it. quick ask: is this a regional spike or global? any customer-facing 500s in recent logs?
junaid: seeing spike concentrated in usw2 frontend proxies. Sampling: 10k reqs/min, 5xx rate ~8% for last 6m. Upstream model runner 502/504s and some 524s. Early logs show 'connection reset by peer' when calling runner. No obvious DB errors.
amanda: adding some quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference-usw2 -l app=inference-gateway -o wide` and `kubectl top pod -n inference-usw2` — can someone run? michael: running now, past 2m:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference-usw2 -l app=inference-gateway
inference-gateway-5f8b9   2/2   Running   1   3h
inference-gateway-6c7d1   2/2   Running   0   3h
inference-gateway-7a9f3   0/2   CrashLoopBackOff   5   15m
```
kubectl top shows one pod saturated CPU at 98% and high network egress on the crashing pod.
sara: CRASHLOOP on a gateway pod coinciding with spike. was there a canary or deploy recently? eng-runtime, any changes in the last hour?
eng-runtime: we pushed a small keepalive/timeout tweak to the gateway sidecar 45m ago to address idle connections. It rolled out to 100% ~30m ago. No model changes.
junaid: that lines up. crashing pod logs show constant TLS handshake timeout errors when dialing model runner pool (keepalive reset). example:
```
2026-03-15T01:26:10Z gateway ERROR dial tcp x.x.x.x:443: handshake timeout
2026-03-15T01:26:11Z gateway ERROR upstream connection reset
```
amanda: hmm. keepalive/timeout tweak may be too aggressive for our runner pool; causing connections to be dropped and gateway to spin trying to reconnect -> overload. Recommend immediate rollback of sidecar change to prior config.
michael: I can start a rollback of the sidecar image to tag `gateway-sidecar:20260220` which was last stable. Starting canary rollback to 20% now.
sara: do it. also enable circuit-breaker on the route so we don't queue bursts to the failing runners. runbook step: change ingress circuit to open after 5 failures for 30s — can someone apply patch?
junaid: applying circuit-breaker patch to istio route now. `kubectl apply -f -` pasted in thread. Patch applied. Confirming rule active.
michael: canary rollback started: patching deployment, scaling pods with old sidecar. Will take ~45s for pods to turn ready.
incident-bot: Note: Auto-suppress: noise gate lowered by 50% while mitigation in progress to avoid thundering pages.
sara: checking customer impact: CS reported two customers seeing increased 500s (org-123, org-489). I pinged CS to notify customers we are investigating. opening a status update at status.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-142
amanda: health metrics: 2m after rollback started: overall 5xx dropping to 3.2% and trending down. latency stable. request rate same.
michael: new pods with old sidecar came up healthy. logs show fewer TLS timeouts. 5xx trending to <1% on the problematic proxy cluster.
sara: nice. keep monitoring for 15m. if stable, we'll promote rollback to 100% and mark incident RESOLVED. handoff: I'll stay for next 20m then hand over to night oncall (michael) if unchanged.
junaid: created brief incident note in INC-2026-142 with timeline, suspected root cause (keepalive/timeout regression), rollback action, customer impact, and follow-up: revert change + add staging test for keepalive churn.
eng-runtime: follow-ups: (1) add canary gating to sidecar deploys for keepalive-related flags, (2) add synthetic test hitting runner pool with long-lived connections, (3) tune circuit breaker thresholds.
sara: ok. next steps: CS update: short note posted to customers, engineering postmortem assigned to junaid/amanda, severity final: SEV2 (customer-visible but mitigated). I'll mark page closed after 20m of stable metrics. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PAGE CLOSED: alert suppressed. Incident INC-2026-142 remains open for follow-up tasks.
